question: What constitutes the root Kaula path for attaining the eight supernatural powers?
premises: The eight supernatural powers are under discussion.
Attainment of these powers is identified with the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed directly to the fair-faced goddess.
inference: The attainment of the eight supernatural powers is itself the essence of the root Kaula practice.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight supernatural powers is the root Kaula.
